messages:
maria: Heads up — discovered a nasty interaction between the JS streaming SDK's dynamic-windowing and our pagination helper in the sampleapp. Stream stops yielding mid-run when concurrency spikes.
aj: ugh. reproduction steps?
mar ia: sorry typo — maria. repro is with sampleapp embeddings demo: start multiple parallel paginated requests (page_size 200) + dynamicWindowing enabled + token-refresh during a long run. After ~30s one stream just hangs and never receives next chunk. No 429s from API.
sam: do you see retries or auth errors in logs?
maria: logs show token refresh at 30s (sts rotate). The SDK emits a single inflight counter drop and then never increments again for that stream. The request is still listed in client state.
kevin: could be a race in the inflight semaphore + stream cancel on auth callback. Does disabling dynamic windowing avoid it?
maria: yes disabling dynamic windowing (set windowing: false) the streams complete fine. Also lowering concurrency to 1 avoids it.
aj: can you paste the minimal config?
maria: sure:
```json
{
  "concurrency": 8,
  "page_size": 200,
  "dynamicWindowing": true,
  "retry": { "maxRetries": 2 },
  "auth": { "refreshInterval": 1800 }
}
```
sam: interesting. sounds like the backpressure path isn't handling auth-induced inflight adjustments. Might be our patch that moved semaphore release into the refresh callback.
kevin: @maria can you run with debug env var SDK_DEBUG=windowing,auth to get verbose traces?
maria: running now. output pasted here: 
```
[DEBUG] windowing: shrink window from 8 -> 4 (latency spike)
[DEBUG] auth: refresh start
[DEBUG] inflight: release token for stream#42
[DEBUG] inflight: acquire token failed (no notify)
[DEBUG] stream#42: waiting for data
```
kevin: that "acquire token failed (no notify)" is suspicious. looks like a missed notify on the condition var.
aj: I can reproduce locally with sampleapp+fixture. I'll try a patch that notifies before releasing the inflight token.
sam: prefer a simpler fix: on auth refresh path, snapshot and drain inflight but don't change the per-stream waiters. We shouldn't mutate waiters mid-flight.
kevin: also check that our pagination cursor logic doesn't double-queue the next page when window shrinks; double-queue + inflight release could starve the stream.
maria: quick workaround for customers: set dynamicWindowing:false or set concurrency to 2 during onboarding. Need to update sampleapp README.
aj: I'll open a PR with two things: (1) small fix in semaphore notify ordering + unit test, (2) sampleapp README note and a telemetry metric for stale-stream-drops.
ci-bot: PR #4321 created by aj: fix(windowing): notify-before-release to avoid missed waiters — testing in CI. :shipit: 
kevin: thanks. once CI passes can we feature-flag the change so Private deployments can toggle? Some customers may rely on current ordering.
aj: will add a feature flag.
maria: thanks all — pro tip for docs: add a small troubleshooting snippet under "onboarding/backpressure":
"If you see streaming stalls during paginated workloads around auth rotate, set dynamicWindowing=false or reduce concurrency. File an issue with SDK debug logs."
